findings.issue: The claimed fixed persona baseline is not preserved: F01-F05, G03-G04, J01 and J03 substitute unrelated API scenarios for the pinned accessibility, assisted-use, scale and endurance needs. Restore those needs and mark unexecuted paths explicitly rather than carrying forward PASS.

The report overstates executable coverage: the suite has no apply-time invalidation, rollback, or REST malformed/oversized-request regression. Lines 45 and 63 likewise call unexecuted paths tested. Separate source inspection from actual test evidence.

The blanket hard-constraint fail-closed claim contradicts validateConstraints(): missing time parameters are skipped and mixed currencies produce a soft warning even for hard budgets. Narrow the claim to tested cases and record these source caveats.
Mandatory idempotency keys apply only to REST apply/rollback. MCP handlers call ProposalService without keys; the report must not extend REST retry guarantees to MCP.

summary: Corrected four documentation defects: fixed persona drift, overstated test coverage, an unsupported blanket hard-constraint claim, and missing REST scope on idempotency. All four new regression tests failed before the corrections; Git Bash npm run check && npm run build now passes with 58 tests and exit 0. The report remains NOT CLEAN / 0/2 and explicitly records unexecuted paths and pre-existing source caveats.
